tom: Yikes. What's the delta?
remo: Raw delta = $3,750. They also had a $250 prepaid platform credit applied earlier, so net customer-facing refund requested = $3,500.
elaine: That exceeds my $1k auto-approve. Tagging @maria for sign-off. We need SRE/ENG confirmation this is a platform migration bug (not customer-side).
remo: Confirmed — migration script missed clearing legacy_pricing flag for a subset of accounts. ENG ticket ENG-4310 opened and assigned to infra. This is on us.
maria: Approved :white_check_mark: — full goodwill credit ok for platform error. Please label reason "goodwill: migration_pricing_error" and include ENG-4310 in ledger note.
remo: Creating manual credit now:
```
# manual goodwill credit for pricing migration error
billingctl credit --customer ATLAS-900 --invoice INV-2026-1234 --amount 3500.00 --currency USD --reason "goodwill: migration_pricing_error" --note "ENG-4310"
```
